title: Kadavul Irukaan Kumaru
desc: Kumar and his friend decide to celebrate the former's bachelor's party before his wedding. However, chaos ensues when the duo are caught by the police for carrying alcohol.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

title: Oh Manapenne
desc: Karthik, an unmotivated graduate and Shruthi, an ambitious entrepreneur, team up to start a food truck, facing challenges that bring them closer.

title: Veerabali
desc: A happy-go-lucky man is forced to adopt violent means to avenge his parents' ruthless murders. So, with the help of his love, he sets out to punish the culprits.

title: Gandhipuram
desc: Afraid of his disapproving father, a boy decides to elope with the girl he loves. Afraid of a greater wrath from his father, the boy's brother tries to convince them to wait.

title: Inidhu Inidhu
desc: Freshmen at an engineering college bond after being picked on by seniors, eventually pairing into couples over their four years at school.

title: Kadal
desc: Unruly Bergman is expelled from his seminary when a kind-hearted fellow student, Sam, exposes his heinous acts. Soon he resolves to teach Sam a lesson that evil does predominate supreme.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Payanam
desc: When terrorists hijack a plane from Chennai, a struggle with the pilots damages the engine forcing them to make an emergency landing in Tirupati. NSG commando Ravi is entrusted with rescue operations.

title: Kaatrin Mozhi
desc: A housewife content with her life still sometimes dreams of independence. Later, her wishes come true when an unexpected opportunity to become a radio jockey arises.

title: Velai Illa Raja
desc: A young man decides to protect his uncle from his nefarious enemy and put an end to his tyranny.

title: Aruvi
desc: Aruvi is a gentle girl, born in an unpleasant environment. She grows up with her own unique perspective, but life doesn't get any easier for her.

title: Frienda Pola Yaaru Machaan
desc: Abhi crosses paths with his long-lost friend, Vasu. Soon, as they reconnect and reminisce old times, their ugly past is revealed.

title: Action
desc: Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit.

title: Malayappa
desc: The home minister asks Tirupathi to impersonate the deceased ACP Baldev, his lookalike, to catch Ganguly, a dreaded gangster. After taking over his new role, he finds many startling revelations.
